none: PAS NLM-EADBD7: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably Constantius II (323-361), probably an irregular copy, possibly of a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]STI[--]. Reverse description: Trace of outer circle, possibly [soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman]. Reverse inscription: possibly [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 11.8mm, Weight: 0.92gms
